cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've shut my notebook like you. Prophecy complete. Stay while we record whether Gran's stone hatched at sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I shut mine against the rain. The sun's down; it's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dry pages, good. Sign that it didn't hatch and we can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

reason: Copying rain-protection closure becomes premature witnessing certainty; actual failed hatch and missing day drive disproof then responsible revision.
